keywords.term: retest of editing mode that is extremely slow to update the HTML mode

record.content: It timed out in attempting to render the HTML mode; thus, I think the problem is on the server, not the client computers. Retest of editing mode that is extremely slow to update the HTML mode, at least as seen on client computer running Windows XT. Preview of this very simple test took in excess of 5 minutes to preview, timed.
